name: Shur
brief: Wilderness area between Canaan and Egypt
short: Shur was a wilderness area between Canaan and Egypt, mentioned in connection with Hagar (<ref="Gen. 16:7">Gen. 16:7</ref>), Abraham (<ref="Gen. 20:1; 25:18">Gen. 20:1; 25:18</ref>), the Israelites' wanderings (<ref="Exod. 15:22">Exod. 15:22</ref>), and Saul's battles (<ref="1Sam. 15:7; 27:8">1Sam. 15:7; 27:8</ref>).
